summary: Subdivides a collision grid into a fixed 32x32 cell raster. Computes each cell's world-space bounding box from the grid center (X at this+8, Z at this+24) and the reciprocal of each axis scale (this+16, this+32), queries the grid data pointer at this+4 via sub_44A880, and stores the returned pointer in a flat output array at this+40. Returns the last query result, or null when the grid pointer at this+4 is null.

operations.description: Load the collision grid data pointer at this+4; if it is null the function returns immediately without iterating.
Compute the X-cell stride as the reciprocal of the X scale at this+16, substituting 0.0 when the scale is exactly 0.0 (guard against divide-by-zero).
Compute the Z-cell stride as the reciprocal of the Z scale at this+32, substituting 0.0 when the scale is exactly 0.0 (guard against divide-by-zero).
Outer do-while loop over 32 rows, tracking the current row index.
Per row, derive the near and far X cell bounds from (row - 0.5) and (row + 0.5) scaled by the X stride.
Inner do-while loop over 32 columns, tracking the current column index.

Build a 4-float cell bounding box: X bounds are the row bounds offset by the grid center X at this+8, Z bounds are (column - 0.5) and (column + 0.5) scaled by the Z stride and offset by the grid center Z at this+24.
Call sub_44A880 with the grid data pointer and the cell bounding box; store the returned query pointer into the output array and advance the array cursor.
Return the last grid query result pointer (or the uninitialized result when the grid pointer was null).

unresolved: The layout and semantics of the structure sub_44A880 returns per cell are unknown; only the returned pointer is stored.
